theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfr_face_divergence
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ι : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) (b : Fin P → ℤ) (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), StrictMono ι → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) γ → (∀ (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (i : Fin (m + 1)), G y i = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * γ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => (b k : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun l => EuclideanSpace.single (ι (Fin.succAbove i l)) (1 : ℝ))) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G ∧ (∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), ‖G y‖ ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm (γ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => (b k : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), exteriorDerivative γ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => (b k : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G y)
